Options:
  -c, --container-name CONTAINER  Select a storage container
  --account-name ACCOUNT  Set storage account
  --auth-mode MODE  Select authentication mode
  --prefix PREFIX  Restrict blob names by prefix
  --num-results NUM  Limit returned blobs
  --marker MARKER  Continue from a listing marker
  --include VALUES  Include additional blob details
  --delimiter DELIMITER  Group blob names by delimiter
  -o, --output FORMAT  Set output format
  --query QUERY  Filter output with JMESPath
  --subscription SUBSCRIPTION  Select subscription
  --only-show-errors  Suppress warnings
  --debug  Include debug logging
  --verbose  Increase logging detail
